recovery.note: Exact 190-writer seed recovered from this Literature chat’s 3 October command record; originally saved only to /private/tmp. Not a completed source-verified candidate list.

limitations: The 50-place boundary is subjective, especially among established writers with similar cases.
A writer omitted here may still win; the original 190-person pool is itself incomplete.
Current source checks support selection and targeted eligibility review, not complete verification of every representative work or a comprehensive live-status registry.
No actual 2026 nominations or committee preferences are known.

Countries_or_contexts retain biographical/literary contexts, not verified citizenship. Literary summaries and representative works are inherited from the original draft; selection sources document contender visibility or recognition only.

scope: The 50 most plausible 2026 winners, by author judgment, within the recovered 190-writer Codex draft. No new writers added.
selection_method: Prioritize mature, distinctive and internationally recognized whole-oeuvre literary achievements.
Use current public contender coverage as supporting evidence of forecasting plausibility, cross-checking multiple sources rather than copying a single market order.
Use no geographic or gender quota, no deterministic alternation assumption, and no artificial numerical probabilities.
Override stale public contender lists when primary evidence identifies ineligibility.
Keep the output alphabetical and remove selection judgments and market evidence from blinded simulation packets.
